title: Wool Items
description: Adds new craftable items and utilities made from wool.
body:
Wool Items is a simple Minecraft mod that expands the use of wool by adding new items and crafting recipes.

🔹 Features:
- New items crafted from different wool colors
- Simple and vanilla-friendly recipes
- Lightweight mod with no performance impact

This mod is perfect for players who want more uses for wool without changing the core gameplay too much.

Compatible with survival worlds.
